Image resizer in pixels

Whether you need a profile picture, a thumbnail or a smaller file for email, resizing takes seconds. Type a width or height and the other side updates automatically to keep the proportions.

How to resize an image

  1. Add your image. Its current size is filled in for you.
  2. Type a new Width or Height. With Keep aspect ratio on, the other value follows automatically.
  3. Or tap 25%, 50% or 75% for a quick scale-down.
  4. Pick a format and click Convert & download.

Resizing tips

  • Make images smaller rather than bigger: enlarging adds no detail and looks soft.
  • Untick Keep aspect ratio only if you want to stretch or squash the picture on purpose.
  • Resizing down is also the quickest way to reduce file size.

Frequently asked questions

How do I resize without losing quality?

Shrink in one go and save as PNG, or as WebP/JPEG at around 85% quality. Large reductions are done in steps with high-quality smoothing to keep edges clean.

What is the maximum size?

Up to 16,384 px per side and 40 megapixels.

Can I also limit the file size in KB?

Yes. Set a Target max size under Format & compression.

Is my image uploaded?

No. Resizing happens in your browser.
